raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

On a **streaming** `/v1/chat/completions` or `/v1/completions` request, every scheduler abort is delivered as an SSE error event inside a `200`, even when the abort arrives before any output was produced:

| abort | status carried | streaming today | non-streaming today |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--max-queued-requests` full | 503 | `200` + `data: {"error": {..., "code": 503}}` | HTTP 503 |
| waiting-queue timeout (`SGLANG_REQ_WAITING_TIMEOUT`) | 503 | same | HTTP 503 |
| priority preemption | 503 | same | HTTP 503 |
| scheduler-side validation (sampling mask, beam) | 400 | same | HTTP 400 |

`_handle_streaming_request` already pulls the first chunk before sending headers so that a validation failure can become a proper HTTP 400 instead of an SSE payload (see the comment there), but it only catches a raised `ValueError`. The scheduler abort comes back through `tokenizer_manager._handle_abort_finish_reason` as an ordinary yielded chunk that `_generate_chat_stream` turns into an error event, so it slips past the pre-read and goes out as a `200`.

This matters for anything in front of the engine: a load balancer or gateway that routes on status cannot tell a queue-full refusal (safe to retry elsewhere, no work was done) from a successful stream without parsing SSE bodies, and `max_queued_requests` loses most of its value as a back-pressure signal for streaming clients, which are the common case for chat.

## Modifications

- `serving_base.py`: `pre_stream_error(first_chunk)` parses the kick-start chunk; if it is an error event carrying an integer status code, it returns `create_error_response` with that message, type and code; otherwise `None`.
- `serving_chat.py`, `serving_completions.py`: after the kick-start, if `pre_stream_error` returns a response, close the generator and return it. A normal first chunk and `[DONE]` are untouched. Mid-stream aborts (headers already out) are unchanged and still arrive in-band.

## Accuracy Tests

Not applicable (no model code).

## Speed Tests and Profiling

One `orjson.loads` of the first chunk per streaming request.

## Unit test

`test_streaming_abort_before_any_output_answers_with_its_status` drives `_handle_streaming_request` with a queue-full abort as the only output and asserts a 503 response with the abort's message and code. It fails on `main` (`200 != 503`) and passes with the change; `test_streaming_abort_yields_error` (mid-stream abort stays in-band) still passes.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).

@@ -213,6 +213,24 @@ def create_error_response(
         )
         return ORJSONResponse(content=error.model_dump(), status_code=status_code)
 
+    def pre_stream_error(self, first_chunk: str) -> Optional[ORJSONResponse]:
+        """An abort that arrived before any output (queue full, waiting timeout, scheduler
+        validation) carries an HTTP status; answer with it instead of a 200 stream."""
+        if not first_chunk.startswith("data: "):
+            return None
+        try:
+            event = orjson.loads(first_chunk[len("data: ") :])
+        except orjson.JSONDecodeError:
+            return None
+        error = event.get("error") if isinstance(event, dict) else None
+        if not isinstance(error, dict) or not isinstance(error.get("code"), int):
+            return None
+        return self.create_error_response(
+            error.get("message", "Generation aborted."),
+            error.get("type", "InternalServerError"),
+            error["code"],
+        )
+
     def create_streaming_error_response(
         self,
         message: str,

@@ -1950,6 +1950,9 @@ async def _handle_streaming_request(
             first_chunk = await generator.__anext__()
         except ValueError as e:
             return self.create_error_response(str(e))
+        if (error := self.pre_stream_error(first_chunk)) is not None:
+            await generator.aclose()
+            return error
 
         async def prepend_first_chunk():
             yield first_chunk

@@ -209,6 +209,9 @@ async def _handle_streaming_request(
             first_chunk = await generator.__anext__()
         except ValueError as e:
             return self.create_error_response(str(e))
+        if (error := self.pre_stream_error(first_chunk)) is not None:
+            await generator.aclose()
+            return error
 
         async def prepend_first_chunk():
             yield first_chunk

@@ -3072,6 +3072,55 @@ async def run_stream():
         self.assertEqual(len(chunks), 2)
         self.assertIn("error", chunks[0])
 
+    def test_streaming_abort_before_any_output_answers_with_its_status(self):
+        """A scheduler abort that arrives before the first output (queue full,
+        waiting timeout, validation) carries an HTTP status; the streaming
+        handler must answer with that status, as the non-streaming path does,
+        instead of a 200 whose body is one error event."""
+        err_msg = "The request queue is full."
+        err_code = HTTPStatus.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE
+
+        async def _mock_generate_abort():
+            yield {
+                "text": "",
+                "meta_info": {
+                    "id": "chatcmpl-test",
+                    "prompt_tokens": 10,
+                    "completion_tokens": 0,
+                    "cached_tokens": 0,
+                    "finish_reason": {
+                        "type": "abort",
+                        "status_code": err_code,
+                        "message": err_msg,
+                    },
+                },
+                "index": 0,
+            }
+
+        self.tm.generate_request.return_value = _mock_generate_abort()
+
+        with patch(
+            "sglang.srt.entrypoints.openai.serving_chat.generate_chat_conv"
+        ) as conv_mock:
+            conv_ins = Mock()
+            conv_ins.get_prompt.return_value = "Test prompt"
+            conv_mock.return_value = conv_ins
+            adapted_request, _ = self.chat._convert_to_internal_request(
+                self.stream_req, self.fastapi_request
+            )
+
+        loop = get_or_create_event_loop()
+        response = loop.run_until_complete(
+            self.chat._handle_streaming_request(
+                adapted_request, self.stream_req, self.fastapi_request
+            )
+        )
+
+        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, err_code.value)
+        body = json.loads(response.body)
+        self.assertEqual(body["message"], err_msg)
+        self.assertEqual(body["code"], err_code.value)
+
     def test_streaming_abort_with_ids_enabled(self):
         """Test that a terminal abort with input/output ids enabled yields only an error and [DONE]."""
         err_msg = "Aborted by scheduler"
